overloadMerges.note: deleteOption is documented as two named constants from the 'System Documents' theme, not an arbitrary Integer; added sentinelValues/enum-style meanings and the default-when-omitted behavior.

params.name: deleteOption
params.description: Deletion mode; if omitted, behaves as 'Delete only if empty' (0).

sentinelValues.meaning: Delete only if empty: fails with error -47 if the folder is not empty (this is also the default when the parameter is omitted)
Delete with contents: deletes the folder and everything it contains, even if locked/read-only (given sufficient access rights)

constraints: If the folder does not exist: with deleteOption omitted/0, error -120 is generated; with deleteOption=1, the command does nothing and no error is returned.

With deleteOption=1, if any contained file cannot be deleted, deletion aborts as soon as the first inaccessible element is found (error -54 on Windows, -45 on macOS), and the folder may be left only partially deleted; use Last errors to find the offending file.
Errors can be intercepted with a method installed via ON ERR CALL.
